cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Získat znalosti fyzikálních vlastností dřeva a materiálů na bázi dřeva jako nezbytného předpokladu pro racionální volbu materiálu a technologií zpracování dřeva v dřevařství, stavebnictví, nábytkářství a tvorbě obývaného prostředí. Osvojit si základy materiálového inženýrství, tepelné techniky, akustiky a metod testování materiálů; poznat vztahy mezi chemickým složením, stavbou a fyzikálními vlastnostmi dřeva.

en.label: Prerequisites:
en.content: Wood Anatomy and not State Bachelor Examination and not Physical Properties of Wood
Syllabus of the course, general rules, requirements for preliminary exam and exam. Safety at practices. (allowance 0/2)
Wood as composite with anisotropic character of its properties based on its chemical composition and anatomical structure. (allowance 2/2)
Wood density and macroscopical structure of wood. (allowance 2/2)
Moisture content, wood moisture relations, sorption isotherma. (allowance 4/2)
Wood hygroexpansion - swelling and shrinkage, wood distortion. (allowance 2/4)
Moisture diffusion - steady-state and unsteady state diffusion of bounded water. (allowance 4/2)
Wood permeability - steady-state and unsteady state permeability of free water. (allowance 4/2)
Thermal properties of wood - conductivity, heat capacity, thermal expansion coefficient. (allowance 1/0)
Thermal Diffusivity - steady-state and unsteady state thermal diffusion. (allowance 2/2)
Electrical properties - resistance and conductivity, dielectric properties. (allowance 1/0)
Acoustic properties - sound velocity, internal friction, vibrational properties. (allowance 2/2)
Optical properties - wood photodegradation. (allowance 2/0)
Calculations of physical properties related examples. Presentation of results. (allowance 0/8)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Knowledge of the properties of wood and wood-based materials as a prerequisite for the rational choice of processing technology and use of wood for structural applications in construction, furniture making and inhabited environments. Material engineering basics, thermal properties, acoustics and methods of material testing; understanding the relationship among chemical composition and anatomical structure and properties of wood.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Syllabus of the course, general rules, requirements for preliminary exam and exam. Safety at practices. (allowance 0/2)2.Wood as composite with anisotropic character of its properties based on its chemical composition and anatomical structure. (allowance 2/2)3.Wood density and macroscopical structure of wood. (allowance 2/2)4.Moisture content, wood moisture relations, sorption isotherma. (allowance 4/2)5.Wood hygroexpansion - swelling and shrinkage, wood distortion. (allowance 2/4)6.Moisture diffusion - steady-state and unsteady state diffusion of bounded water. (allowance 4/2)7.Wood permeability - steady-state and unsteady state permeability of free water. (allowance 4/2)8.Thermal properties of wood - conductivity, heat capacity, thermal expansion coefficient. (allowance 1/0)9.Thermal Diffusivity - steady-state and unsteady state thermal diffusion. (allowance 2/2)10.Electrical properties - resistance and conductivity, dielectric properties. (allowance 1/0)11.Acoustic properties - sound velocity, internal friction, vibrational properties. (allowance 2/2)12.Optical properties - wood photodegradation. (allowance 2/0)13.Calculations of physical properties related examples. Presentation of results. (allowance 0/8)
